images.name: putting-it-all-together
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square illustration beside a presentation title "Putting it all together". Editorial photographic cut-paper collage matching the supplied reference: warm ivory #EFEAE0 paper, grayscale photo cutouts with cream edges, muted teal #A3CFCB and yellow #FFE234 torn paper, vermilion #E5432F accents, sparse black halftone dots, fine paper grain and shallow shadows. Sophisticated independent technology magazine aesthetic, bold clean Archivo-like labels. No robots, neon, glossy 3D, logos or watermark. A grayscale laptop is the central subject. On its left, a cutout human hand plugs a red cable into the laptop; the cable connects to a neat small group of three cream instruction sheets and a small grayscale tool-shaped connector, suggesting project context, rules, skills and external tools wired into one workflow. On the right, one completed software-package paper with a bold vermilion checkmark emerges from the laptop, with one small simple curved red paper loop leading back toward the laptop to suggest verification and feedback. Laptop screen contains only abstract black and cream code strokes. Large recognizable objects, sparse balanced composition, 10 percent safe margins. Square 1:1. No words, letters, numerals or captions. Do not make a multi-panel infographic; one cohesive still-life collage.

images.name: shift-left-verification
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: wide 2:1 slide, editorial collage recreation of a four-stage generation and verification diagram. Editorial photographic cut-paper collage matching the supplied reference: warm ivory #EFEAE0 paper, grayscale photo cutouts with cream edges, muted teal #A3CFCB and yellow #FFE234 torn paper, vermilion #E5432F accents, sparse black halftone dots, fine paper grain and shallow shadows. Sophisticated independent technology magazine aesthetic, bold clean Archivo-like labels. No robots, neon, glossy 3D, logos or watermark. 
Title across top on cream torn paper "Verification at every step".
Four equal vertical columns in chronological LEFT-to-RIGHT order: "Issue", "Plan", "Uncommitted code", "Pull request". IMPORTANT preserve this exact order.
Two continuous rectangular colored paper bands run horizontally across the four columns: TOP band pale yellow with a left-margin label "Verification"; BOTTOM band muted teal with a left-margin label "Generation". Give the label column sufficient room. The four columns are aligned in both bands.
In each TOP column, one cream paper review note with large black text:
above Issue: "Is the ask clear and complete?"
above Plan: "Does the plan fit the issue?"
above Uncommitted code: "Is the change right so far?"
above Pull request: "Is it ready to merge?"
Below each review note, one straight vertical VERMILION arrow points DOWN to its corresponding generation artifact in the lower band.
Each BOTTOM column contains one compact grayscale photographic artifact cutout and a cream paper title label below. Issue: a short paper task sheet with abstract ink strokes. Plan: a paper blueprint/outline with abstract strokes. Uncommitted code: a laptop showing abstract code. Pull request: two code papers joined with a simple checkmark. No readable writing in the photos. Under those photo objects place the four exact large titles: "Issue", "Plan", "Uncommitted code", "Pull request". Smaller subtitle under each: "What's asked", "How it'll be built", "Work in progress", "Ready for merge". Black horizontal arrows between lower artifacts point RIGHT, showing development progression.
Below both bands, a single long LEFT-POINTING vermilion arrow labeled "Earlier feedback" emphasizes moving verification earlier from pull request to uncommitted code, plan and issue. Only that bottom arrow points LEFT. Do not reverse chronological stage order.
Make every label crisp, generously spaced, fully readable. No terminal window chrome, extra text, extra stages or extra arrows. Review checks sit above the corresponding artifacts. Conceptual adaptation from tester-2 ReviewAtEveryStep.vue; retain all four checks and development stages.
